x: But Matt Douglas, Dan Donovan, Chris Moss and Sean Baldock got the silver and we were home and dry. John Jeffery says he only smiles at the big matches when we are certain to lose.
In the 100 A event Lawrence Oboh's blocks slipped but Dan Donovan made amends by winning the B in his first race for the club on home shores.
New member Dan Donovan made an impressive start while under 23 year olds Scot Thompson, Greg Beard, Seni Majekodunmi, and Dominic Girdler made significant contributions.
